component.name: Shellrunner
component.summary: Lightweight browser for developers, with a built-in terminal
Browser leggero per sviluppatori, con terminale integrato

description.p: Shellrunner puts a WebKit browser and a real terminal in the same window, with a command palette for every action and privacy protections on by default.

ul.li: Built-in terminal and the sr command to drive the browser from the shell
Command palette, local dev server detection, network log, responsive view
HTTPS-only, tracker blocklist, anti-fingerprinting, Global Privacy Control
Optional local AI assistant through Ollama
No telemetry, no accounts, no update pings
